When those inventions first originated, we did abandon horses and small scale presses. However, I believe that these brought forward new ways of expressing our humanity. The Dystopian view claims that we will lose our humanity by replacing humans with machines. However, I have seen some excellent art being created with different image generation models. People who previously did not have the resources to hire voice actors, get writing lessons, or learn to draw can now create their own works of art.
